design: Insert a pipeline register on the multiply inputs (multa_r, multb_r) inside butterfly so the DSP input-select mux driven by modei is separated from the multiply by one register stage, adding +1 latency per butterfly instance; butterfly2x2 chains two instances for NTT modes so the system-visible shift is +2 for FNTT and INTT, and +2 for MULT/ADD/SUB. All downstream taps (valid_sr reads, z2_sr/z3_sr taps, addr1_sr taps, drain counters) are retapped by +2 per mode independently.

Insert a pipeline register (`mult_pre`) between the combinational multiplier and `mult_p`, breaking the modei-mux→DSP critical path. Each butterfly gains +1 latency; for FNTT/MULT (no BF chain in these modes at system level within butterfly2x2's second stage) the output shifts +1, and for INTT (two chained butterfly stages in butterfly2x2) the system output shifts +2; all valid_sr taps, z2_sr/z3_sr delay-line taps, addr1_sr write-address taps, and pause counters are retapped per mode.

Add one pipeline register (mult_pre) between mult_result and mult_p inside butterfly, breaking the modei-mux-to-DSP critical path. Each butterfly stage gains +1 cycle; butterfly2x2 chains two stages for FNTT/INTT giving +2 total system shift for those modes, while MULT/ADD/SUB use unchained BF stages giving +1 total; all valid_sr taps, z2_sr/z3_sr zeta delay lines, addr1_sr write-address taps, and pause counters are retapped per-mode using the correct total shift.

Insert pipeline registers on the multiply operands (multa/multb) inside butterfly.v so the 24×24 multiply is isolated to one cycle; this adds +1 internal stage per butterfly instance. FNTT and INTT chain two butterfly stages in butterfly2x2 giving +2 total system shift; MULT_MODE butterflies run in parallel giving +1 total shift; ADD_MODE and SUB_MODE never use the multiplier giving +0 shift.

Add one pipeline register on multiplier inputs inside butterfly (+1 per butterfly stage). FNTT and INTT chain two butterfly stages giving +2 total; MULT does not chain giving +1 total; ADD/SUB skip multiplier giving +0. FNTT/INTT pause drain counter extended by +2 to prevent round-2 read-after-write hazard. z2_sr taps for BF2 zeta: FNTT original BF1 latency 9→10 so z2_sr[9]; INTT original BF1 latency 11→12 so z2_sr[11].

reason: Registering the DSP operand desyncs the multiply path from the index-matched additive delay lines (aj3/zeta_delay3/ajlen3) and requires mode-asymmetric downstream retaps (+2 NTT chained, +1 MULT) whose internal barrett-vs-adder realignment cannot be safely derived from the provided RTL without risking path-desync corruption.
